items.summary_en: Poland's president signed a law that bans keeping dogs and cats on chains at home. From next year, pets must live inside the house, in a fenced garden, or in a large enough kennel with daily exercise. The ban passed after months of debate between lawmakers and the president over earlier versions of the bill.
